decision.summary: A confirmed temporary offset occurs in N/E/U from index 370 to 385 (coherent multi-axis drop). A subsequent ambiguous rebound interval (400–410) shows opposing E/U behavior without full recovery; status uncertain due to incomplete return and possible superposed motion. No other temporary offsets are confirmed within allowed context [365, 545].

intervals.observation: N/E/U show a correlated multi-sample drop (370–385), with coherent negative excursion across all axes; onset is gradual over ~5 samples, interior sustained for ~10 samples, no opposing return observed within this sub-interval.

E and U exhibit opposing rebounds (400–410) while N remains depressed; the recovery is noisy and incomplete, and no clear return to pre-event baseline is observed on any axis. Return phase ambiguous; superposed motion likely.
